title: I KNOW WHO HOLDS TOMORROW
author: Ira Stamphill
stanzas: I don't know about tomorrow, I just live from day to day; I don't borrow from the sunshine, For the skies may turn to gray. I don't worry o'er the future For I know what Jesus said And today He walks beside me And He knows what is ahead

Ev'ry step is getting brighter, As the golden stairs I climb; Ev'ry burden's getting lighter; Ev'ry cloud is silver lined. There the sun is always shining, there no ear will dim the eyes. At the ending of the rainbow, Where the mountains touch the sky

I don't know about tomorrow, It may bring me poverty; But the one who feed the sparrow Is the One who stands by me. And the path that is my portion, May be through the flame or blood But His presence goes before me, And I'm covered with His blood.
chorus: Many things about tomorrow I don't seem to understand But I know who holds tomorrow Oh, and I know who holds my hand
